anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, C1 (the input decoupling capacitor on the Display_Power_Switch rail, in parallel with C2) is drawn with value '0.1uF/16V'.
anomalies.expected: The specification's component-matching table explicitly assigns C1 to the PDI 'C2 default' group of 1 µF/25 V capacitors (C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V). A 0.1 µF/16 V part is neither the stated value nor the stated voltage rating.

evidence.quote: C1 0.1uF/16V  (EPD_Driver.kicad_sch, page 5, left of the boost converter, between Display_Power_Switch and GND)
C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default

anomalies.impact: The EPD power-switch/boost-input rail loses the 1 µF bulk decoupling the reference design specifies (only 0.1 µF remains, plus C2), and the 16 V rating is below the 25 V the reference calls for. This is a deviation from the intended PDI G1-group implementation; behaviour impact is minor (slightly poorer transient filtering on the display rail) but it is a clear value/rating mismatch against the spec.

parsed.summary: Most of the build matches the specification (FAN53610 topology and EN/MODE/FB wiring, barrel-jack battery-disconnect, Q2 high-side switch with R2 pull-up, EPD part numbers and G1 values, reset switch, UART header). The one deviation I can evidence is C1, drawn as 0.1 µF/16 V on the Display_Power_Switch rail whereas the spec lists C1 among the 1 µF/25 V group, so I report it as a wrong-value/wrong-rating anomaly with moderate confidence.
